title: Brooklyn Street, Belleville Park and the Durand and Humphrey band
summary: Nothing on Brooklyn Street; Young Men Hall and Belleville Park, where Durand and Humphrey's band with Peter on violin played.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: No, I never thought about going around there.
You never went over to Brooklyn Street here?
Yeah, yeah, I've been up Brooklyn Street.
You never used to tell me about it.
They ain't had anything on Brooklyn Street as I know of, my dear.
Not on Brooklyn Street. No honky-tonks, or?
I could be wrong, you know, but I just thought, he told me about playing in some dive. That might have been before your time, though. I didn't.

Yeah. But, I don't know anything about that, because I never know them to have anything on Brooklyn Street. Well, it seems to me, tell me, here, the men went back down there. The only thing I can remember over here, in my time, we had, uh, the Young Men Hall back here, we had the Belleville Park over here on Belleville Street. Well, at that time, they had, uh, Durand and Umphrey band, uh, Peter was playing, Peter was playing fiddle at that time, playing violin. Well, which, which Humphrey was that? Oh, that was way back, I was a youngster then, that was, I was young about 18, 19 years ago. Willie's- Willie and Percy's father?
Yeah. Was Willie and Percy's father in that band or was it-

Well, uh, I don't know what they tell me- old man up there with the professor, I don't know, I never met the old man, but I know Willie and all of them, because Percy and Willie and Oil, because I played with all of them.
Well who was Duran? Who was Duran? Duran? Oh he was a trumpet player. Oh. Yeah.

That's Maurice, or his father? He was, Duran played with, with Peter and then, let's say they had Duran, that's like what they do running up the band at that time. And had a fellow by the name of Trappee played drum. Trappee, huh? Yeah, just called him Trappee. Kind of drums came through with you. He was a nice drummer. That's not Nines. Huh? That's Nines? Yes, is that the same guy they call Nines? Yeah, yeah, yeah. Yeah, but he used to call him Trappee for, I guess they call him that for sure. Yeah, Trappanier. Yeah. Yeah.
